claim_text: Al Jazeera reported that at least five Palestinians were injured on Sunday when an Israeli strike hit a tent encampment in Khan Younis, and that a separate air strike hit an apartment in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, wounding several people, according to medics.
quote: At least five Palestinians were injured on Sunday after an Israeli strike hit a tent encampment in Khan Younis, medics said. A separate air strike hit an apartment in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, wounding several people, medics said.
confidence_justification: Casualty figures attributed to unnamed medics on the day of the strike; initial counts commonly revise.
